user.title: Connect eModul
user.description: Sign in to the account that contains your DEFRO controller. Your password is used only to create a session and is not stored by this integration.

module.title: Select DEFRO controller
module.description: Creates 317 reading entities plus live controls and the ST-9730 menu card. Enter known menu codes when required by eModul.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to eModul again
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in with access to the same controller. Existing entities and history are preserved.

reconfigure.title: Menu access
reconfigure.description: Enter known main menu codes. Empty fields remove stored main codes. Submenu codes added in the card are retained. Entering a code does not change boiler settings.

error.rate_limit: eModul rate limit reached. Try later.
error.wrong_account: This account cannot access the configured controller.

abort.no_supported_module: No supported pellet DEFRO controller found.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: Controller does not match the existing configuration.
